IT general controls inquiries
HANGS Construction Services LLC
Systems: Ledgerwyn, Vellumrow, Charterfold and Quillpost
Asked by: the attest team, August 4, 2026
Answered by: Dana Whitfield, Controller
Answered on: August 5, 2026
Status: answers in writing; not a representation letter
Q1 Leavers. How is system access removed when someone leaves?
Answer: HR emails the Office Manager, who disables the Quillpost account. Ledgerwyn and Charterfold accounts are removed by their owners when they hear about it; there is no checklist.
Q2 Access review. When were user rights last reviewed against job duties?
Answer: When the bank portal was set up in 2023. We have not reviewed them since.
Q3 The Ledgerwyn admin account. Who uses the built-in Ledgerwyn administrator account?
Answer: The Controller and Saltmarsh IT Services LLC, for upgrades and year-end work. We share the password; it was last changed in 2024.
Q4 Multi-factor sign-in. Why are some Quillpost accounts exempt from multi-factor sign-in?
Answer: The CEO and the AP Specialist found the codes slowed them down on their phones; the others were set up before we enforced it and were never added.
Q5 Vellumrow approval limit. Why was the AP Specialist’s payment approval limit raised in September 2025?
Answer: The Controller asked Vellumrow support by email so small payments would not wait for her. There was no ticket; the CFO was not asked.
Q6 Changes. How are changes to the financial systems approved and tested?
Answer: Upgrades and new settings get a ticket, a test and the CFO’s approval before they go in. Small settings are made by whoever owns the system.
Demonstration document. Every name and figure is invented.
